Run the cohort explorer

Source: R/explorer_app.R
run_explorer.Rd

Starts an interactive Shiny explorer for a cohort built with rendehR: an overview, a cohort explorer (a characteristics table with SMDs, distributions, outcomes with Wilson confidence intervals, Kaplan-Meier survival, cross-tabs, scatter plots), a subject explorer that reads each patient's harmonized time series live (timeline, time-series panels, medications, diagnoses and per-patient verification), a concept browser with a concept builder, project setup and data checks. Optional spinal cord injury (SCI) pages are added when sci is given.

Usage

run_explorer(
  schema = NULL,
  db_name = NULL,
  creds = NULL,
  config_path = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  sci = NULL,
  raw_dirs = NULL,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = NULL,
  launch.browser = interactive()
)

Arguments

schema

Merged schema to explore (the target_schema of merge_sources()). When NULL, "rendehr_admission" (the setup assistant's default) is used if it exists, otherwise "rendehr" (the default of merge_sources()).

db_name, creds, config_path

Passed to ehr_connect() when credentials have not been stored yet (or when db_name is given).

data

Optional prebuilt bundle from explorer_data(); schema is then ignored.

sci

Optional SCI extension from explorer_sci_data().

raw_dirs

Optional raw data directories per source, see explorer_data().

cache_dir

Optional directory where the data bundle is cached between runs, see explorer_data(). Starting from the cache skips reading the merged tables; it holds individual-level data.

host, port

Where the app listens.

launch.browser

Open a browser window.

Value

Called for its side effect (runs until stopped); returns the value of shiny::runApp() invisibly.

Details

The app serves individual-level data and listens on 127.0.0.1 by default. Do not deploy it publicly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_use_config("config/ehr_config.json")
ehr_connect()
run_explorer("rendehr_admission")
} # }
